title: What Magnetocaloric Refrigeration Systems Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Magnetocaloric refrigerators cool without compressors or refrigerant gases: magnetic materials heat up in a magnetic field and cool when removed — cycling the field pumps heat with no greenhouse gases and higher efficiency. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Magnetocaloric Refrigeration Systems: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.

Why it matters: Cooling demand triples by 2050; magnetocalorics cool without climate-warming refrigerants..
Where it is used: refrigerators, air conditioning, heat pumps, medical cooling..
